text:
Cass: Thinking about running this as a tiny workshop instead of a talk 1) 25m demo + 15m hands-on lab + 10m office hours follow-up. keeps folks engaged and gives a lead magnet. thoughts?
Vik: love workshop format. we can publish a reproducible notebook and short lab tasks. attendees who complete lab can opt into a follow-up office hours slot.
Rhea: agree. marketing angle: "Hands-on: cut token spend in a sprint". we should gate the workshop with a short form that captures model usage + cloud spend band so SDRs can prioritize.
Tom: on lead routing: propose two buckets from the form -> (1) request cost audit (high intent) -> route to SDR queue A, (2) general interest -> nurture sequence. can wire with our webhook to HubSpot.
Cass: run-of-show draft:
0:00-0:03 Welcome & goals (Cass)
0:03-0:28 Live demo playbook (Vik)
0:28-0:43 Guided lab (attendees follow notebook)
0:43-0:50 Office hours signups + next steps (Rhea/Tom)
Vik: demo will show baseline -> batching -> prefix cache -> model routing to a quantized variant. will include p50/p95 + token-cost-per-1k slides and quick CLI commands.
Rhea: marketing tasks: 3 headline variants, 2 CTA paths (Checklists vs Workshop ticket), landing page form with 3 qualification fields, and nurture email sequences. I'll draft by tomorrow. :memo:
Tom: technical snippet for demo health-check + model pin: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/health | jq .status` and `MODEL=redwood-2b-rc && curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"'$MODEL'","input":"hi"}'`
Cass: prerecord a 90s fallback of the demo and a short narrated lab walkthrough in case of live issues. Vik can do those.
StageBot: Workshop rehearsal scheduled: Thu 09:30 PT (tech check)  Thu 16:00 PT (full run). Invitees: Cass, Vik, Rhea, Tom. Link: https://events.redwood.example/workshop_3160000000
Vik: will upload notebook + fallback clips to drive and add a tiny deploy script for attendees to run locally.
Rhea: on lead routing copy: Tom, please share the webhook payload fields you need so I can add them to the form.
Tom: will post a sample payload in the drive and set up a Zap test. also will add a UTM field so we can A/B headlines and attribute channels.
Cass: OK next steps: Rhea drafts page+CTAs, Vik uploads demo+lab, Tom wires routing test, StageBot will remind 24h before rehearsal. We'll review at tech check. :rocket:
